facts.label: Business process
facts.description: Case level: read from the application. The process the application belongs to (always account_opening in this environment); rules of other processes condition on it.

facts.label: Customer type
facts.description: Case level: read from the application.

facts.label: Product
facts.description: Case level: read from the application.

facts.label: Governing state
facts.description: Case level: read from the application. Two-letter state code.

facts.label: Opening channel
facts.description: Case level: read from the application. How the customer opened the account.

facts.label: Party role
facts.description: Party level: one value per party.

facts.label: Citizenship
facts.description: Party level: one value per party. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes the party declared on the application. Multi-valued: a set per party; eq/in hold when any value matches.

facts.label: Country of residence
facts.description: Party level: one value per party. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code the party declared on the application.

facts.label: Age at submission
facts.description: Party level: one value per party. Whole years from date_of_birth to applications.submitted_at, computed by Studio when the registry case is written. The agent sees only the dates.

derivation.description: Whole years from the date of birth to the submission date.

facts.label: Address type
facts.description: Party level: one value per party. Classified by Studio from the address on the party's proof of address when the registry case is written. The agent sees only the address.

derivation.description: street, apo_fpo_dpo, next_of_kin or po_box, read from the address text.

facts.label: Documents presented
facts.description: Party level: one value per party. The kinds of the party's documents. Multi-valued: a set per party; eq/in hold when any value matches.

facts.label: Relationship to the first party
facts.description: Party level: one value per party. The relationship the application declares between this party and the application's first party (self for the first party). Documentary support, when presented, is a relationship_evidence document.

facts.label: Account purpose
facts.description: Case level: read from the application. The purpose the applicant states. Proposed values; the bank expert replaces them.

facts.label: Days since the ID was issued
facts.description: Party level: one value per party. Days from the issue date of the party's identity document (government ID or passport; the most recent if several) to applications.submitted_at, computed by Studio when the registry case is written. The agent sees only the dates.

derivation.description: Days from the most recent identity document's issue date to the submission date.

facts.label: Minor accounts opened by this custodian before
facts.description: Party level: one value per party. The count of the bank's existing minor accounts with this party as custodian, opened in the 365 days before submission (the bank's own records, an existing_accounts collection the environment adds). Computed by Studio when the registry case is written.

derivation.description: Existing minor accounts with this party as custodian opened in the window before submission.

facts.label: Product line
facts.description: Case level: read from the application. Always deposit in this environment; loan, credit card and mortgage rules condition on it, so they never apply (distractors).

facts.label: Branch
facts.description: Case level: read from the application. The branch the application belongs to; its location is in the branches collection.

facts.label: Distance from address to branch
facts.description: Party level: one value per party. Miles from the address on the party's proof of address to the branch. The audit records within_10_miles from it; it has no decision effect.

derivation.description: Great-circle miles from the address's geocode to the branch's location.

facts.label: U.S. residency status
facts.description: Party level: one value per party. Declared on the application: none, lawful_permanent_resident or other_resident. Used only if the approved U.S. person definition (option B) or a bank rule (option C) needs it.
